# Sample app data

**Sample data.** These files are generated by the real pipeline from
`transform/data/sample/raw/` (a small, real cut of the KC inspection and Census geocoder
data), not hand-written. The one exception upstream: the Claude classifications in that
cut are **hand-labelled** (`model: "sample-hand-labelled"`), not API output; see
`transform/data/sample/README.md`.

The app reads these only when `app/data/{openings,metrics,manifest}.json` (the real export,
git-ignored) are absent, and the UI labels them as sample data.

Regenerate after changing the marts or the raw sample:

```sh
cd transform
uv run --python 3.12 dbt build --profiles-dir . --vars '{raw_root: data/sample/raw}'
uv run --python 3.12 python export.py --db kcne.duckdb --out ../app/data/sample   # RAW_BUCKET unset
```

Ages (`days_open`, `freshness`, `score`) are relative to the raw cut's pull date, so they
stay fixed until the raw sample is refreshed; `built_at` changes on every regeneration.
